decision_basis: The product owner authorized sale of the complete self-contained ARE software under the latest license direction specified by Keld.

distribution.included_scope: complete ARE Candidate 018 successor product closure
distribution.customer_receives: the complete self-contained ARE successor source closure

supported_surface.promotion_rule: A package import or schema becomes supported only through a successor release-policy decision and compatibility evidence.

version_policy.predecessor_policy: The first accepted version has no supported predecessor and no migration path.

change_policy.corrections: Preserve published notes and append dated corrections that identify the affected release.
change_policy.deprecation_window: Retain a deprecated supported contract through at least one subsequent accepted minor release.
change_policy.security_exception: An urgent security removal may shorten the deprecation window when the release note identifies the reason and replacement or mitigation.

activation_gates: approve exact license text and rights/notice review for the complete successor closure
freeze and verify a successor product candidate carrying version 0.10.0-rc.1
select a trusted signing identity and authenticated delivery path
perform the separate tag and publication effects
claim_limit: This selects the commercial full-software offer, candidate Keld license direction, version, support-surface, tag, changelog, correction, deprecation, and predecessor policy. It does not execute legal terms, rename Candidate 018, create a successor, accept payment, tag, sign, publish, deliver, deploy, or activate support.

license_direction.resale_rule: Selling a redistributed software copy requires an added function or integration.
license_direction.superseded_direction: The older Keld Apache-2.0 direction is historical and conflicts with the latest owner intent.
license_direction.finalization_gate: Approve exact legal text and complete ownership, third-party notice, trademark, patent, and target-market review before sale.

commercial_identity.successor_identity_rule: Customer-facing successor artifacts use only ARE and Keld identities; legacy repository-wrapper names, paths, and product identifiers must not appear.
